C002.reason: v2 Entity.entity_id is now bytes (ByteString); must be converted to a string via UTF-8 for the observations dictionary.

C004.reason: v2 Entity.entity_id is now bytes; must be encoded from the sample string using UTF-8.

rationale: The schema change for v2 Entity.entity_id from string to bytes requires updating the runtime to handle Google.Protobuf.ByteString. In the previous attempt, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString was called directly on a ByteString, which caused a compiler error because it requires a byte array. I have corrected this by calling .ToByteArray() on the ByteString before decoding. The construction of the v2 sample is updated to use ByteString.CopyFromUtf8 to maintain the identifier 'cs_202'.
assumptions: The generated bindings for Simulation.V2.Entity now use ByteString for EntityId.
